title: Karnataka High Court quashes postal ballot tampering case against former Chikkamagaluru DC, BJP leader Jeevaraj
description: The High Court of Karnataka has quashed criminal case registered in 2026 against former Chikkamagaluru Deputy Commissioner K.N. Ramesh, Returning Officer Vedamurthy T.R. and BJP leader D.N. Jeevaraj over alleged tampering of postal ballots after counting of votes in 2023 in the elections held to Sringeri Assembly constituency
